newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - Le Monde - Feb 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Le Monde - Feb 20.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Artists, citizens and politicians who signed petition against part of bill tightening control of immigration call for a total withdrawal of the bill.
-- Federation of insurance companies looks for a successor for president Denis Kessler who is leaving to join Axa - UAP.
-- Finance Minister Jean Arthuis calls for a restructuring of the French banking system.
-- State could decrease stake in Bull to under 20 percent as early as 1997.

-- Government decides to privatise Thomson-CSF via private placement with a book of terms and conditions, state to retain a "golden share" in the capital of Thomson-CSF allowing it to protect national defence interests.

-- Dassault-Aviation chairman Serge Dassault says he does not want to merge with Aerospatiale if privatisation is not implemented the same day. Subsidiary Dassault-Systemes to remain outside of the merger, as is Dassault's stake in Sabca.
